name: K-Means Lab
desc: A k-means clustering lab: k, point-count and blob-spread sliders drive Lloyd's algorithm over Gaussian blobs, with inertia tracked every iteration.
controls: Cluster-count, point-count and blob-spread sliders, four presets (2/3/4 blobs, rings), step/run/reset buttons, draggable centres; keys 1–4 load presets, S steps, G runs, R resets
creator: Original build (Dragon Gaming Assets)
